default.name: assessment_create
default.description: Create a repeatable Quality Plan Assessment for an immutable evaluation subject digest.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_create_successor
default.description: Create one immutable READY retry successor for a DECIDED, STALE, CANCELLED, or explicitly retried EVIDENCE_REVIEW assessment. The predecessor evidence and decision are never changed.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_decide
default.description: Issue an AssessmentDecision for a reviewed Quality Plan Assessment with current requirement alignment.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.description: Read the current assessment readiness, runtime, and sealed-evidence diagnostic packet.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_execution_authorization_issue
default.description: Exchange a compact Ed25519 host assertion for one target-bound credential execution grant. This operation never accepts UI issuance or credential values.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_execution_authorization_revoke
default.description: Deny an unconsumed credential execution grant. Consumed grants cannot be revoked.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_finding_record
default.description: Record a hash-bound obligation finding from sealed evidence. Only target_defect attribution may violate an obligation.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_prepare_run

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: assessment_review
default.description: Read the assessment review packet, alignment status, evidence hash, assurance observations, and decision blockers. Human-verification blocked evidence remains targetOutcome not_evaluated.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.description: Resolve an exact target environment or explicitly create an immutable proposal with allowCreate: true.

default.name: environment_list
default.description: List bounded target-scoped environment summaries; a current registry hash returns an unchanged receipt.

default.name: execution_consent_decide
default.description: Grant or deny one execution manifest under the target consent policy. Consent is separate from credential authorization.

responseMode.description: Response projection: summary (compact default), decisionOnly (decision hash/status/counts), evidenceOnly, blockersOnly, linksOnly, or full (largest payload).

default.name: locator_ensure

default.name: locator_graph_query
default.description: Query a bounded locator graph path within the target bound to a Quality Plan. fromId is required; omitted optional filters are normalized to absent.

default.name: locator_search
default.description: Search target- and Quality Plan-scoped locators by locator name, selector, group, module, or route before validation design.

default.name: operation_read
default.description: Read exact canonical operation descriptors and handler identities for selected references.

default.name: operation_search

default.name: project_add
default.description: Register either one local application workspace or one remote HTTP(S) black-box target. Local registration may initialize Git and write a non-blocking continuity marker; remote registration creates its initial environment without workspace access.

default.name: project_list
default.description: List application repositories attached to the local AppraiseJS hub.
